English: Point of care (POC) testing in communities, home settings, and primary healthcare centers is believed to have tremendous potential in reducing delays in diagnosing and initiating treatment for diseases such as HIV, tuberculosis, syphilis, and malaria.
Luganda: Kikkirizibwa nti okwekebereza mu bifo ewafunibwa obujjanjabi (POC) mu bitundu, mu maka, ne mu malwaliro amakulu kulina obusobozi bwa maanyi obukendeeza ku kulwisibwa okubeerawo mu kukebera n’okugaba eddagala ly’endwadde gamba nga HIV, akafuba, kabootongo, n’omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Ìdánwò Ìlera níbi Ìtọ́jú (POC) ní àwọn agbègbè, ètò ìdílé, àti àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn ìjọba, jẹ́ ohun tí ìgbàgbọ́ wà fún pé ó ń kó ipa pàtàkì nínú ìdínkù ìdádúró nínú ìṣàtú́palẹ̀ àmì àìsàn àti ìṣèdásílẹ̀ ìtọ́jú fún àwọn àrùn bíi HIV, ikọ́ ifẹ, sífílíìsì, àti ibà.
Zulu: Ukuhlolelwa Endaweni Yokunakekelwa (POC) emiphakathini, ezindaweni zasekhaya, nasezikhungweni zezempilo eziyisisekelo kukholakala ukuthi kunamandla amakhulu ekwehliseni ukubambezeleka ekuxilongeni nasekuqaliseni ukwelashwa kwezifo ezinjenge-HIV, isifo sofuba, ugcunsula, nomalaleveva.
Hausa: Gwajin wurin kulawa (POC) a cikin al’ummomi, wuraren gida da cibiyoyin kiwon lafiya na farko an yi imanin suna da babban tasiri wajen rage jinkirin ganowa da fara jiyya ga cututtuka irin su cutar HIV da tarin fuka da ƙuraje da kuma zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Teko go mafelo a tlhokomelo (POC) ka ditšhabeng, ditikologong tša ka gae, le mafelong a tlhokomelo ya maphelo ya motheo bg dumelwa gore e na le kgonagalo ya go ditela go phekola le go thomiša go alafa malwetši a go swana le HIV, TB, thosola, le letadi.
Amharic: በማኅበረሰቦች፣ በቤት ውስጥ፣ እና በአንደኛ ደረጃ የጤና አጠባበቅ ማዕከላት ውስጥ ያለው ከላብራቶሪ ውጪ የህክምና ምርመራ (POC) ፍተሻ እንደ ኤችአይቪ፣ ሳንባ ነቀርሳ፣ ቂጥኝ፣ እና ወባ ያሉ በሽታዎችን በመመርመር እና የህክምና መጀመር መዘግየቶችን በመቀነስ ረገድ ትልቅ አቅም እንዳለው ይታመናል።

English: Quick diagnosis and further management decisions completed in the same clinical encounter or at least the same day, while the patient waits, promise to overcome delays associated with conventional laboratory-based testing.
Luganda: Okukebera amangu n’okusalawo okulala okuddirira ebikolebwa mu kifo ewajjanjabirwa kyekimu oba waakiri ku lunaku lwerumu, ng’omulwadde alindiridde, biwa essuubi ly’okumalawo okulwisibwa okwekuusa ku kukeberebwa okukolebwa mu makeberero g’endwadde.
Yoruba: Ìtúpalẹ̀ àìsàn ní kíákíá àti àwọn ìpinnu ìṣàkóso tó pé tẹ̀síwájú nínú ìpàdé ìṣèwòsàn  tàbí ní ó kéré jù, ọjọ́ kan náà, bí aláìsàn ṣe ń dúró, ṣèlérí láti borí àwọn ìdádúró tó rọ̀ mọ́ ìlànà ṣíṣàyẹ̀wò oní-láàbù tó ti mọ́ra.
Zulu: Ukuxilongwa okusheshayo kanye nezinqumo ezengeziwe zokuphatha eziphothulwe ekuhlanganeni okufanayo komtholampilo noma okungenani ngosuku olufanayo, ngenkathi isiguli sisalindile, sithembisa ukunqoba ukubambezeleka okuhlobene nokuhlolwa okuvamile okusekelwe elabhorethri.
Hausa: Bincika cuta mai sauri da ƙarin yanke shawara na gudanarwa da aka kammala a cikin haɗuwar asibiti ɗaya ko aƙalla rana guda, a yayin da majiyyaci yake jira, ya yi alƙawarin shawo kan jinkirin da yake tattare da gwajin tushen ɗakin gwaje-gwaje na yau da kullum.
Northern Sotho: Phekolo ya ka pela le dipheto tše dingwe tša taolo tšeo di dirilwego ka mošomo wa tša kalafo goba bonyane ka letšatši le tee, mola e le gore molwetši o emetše, go tshephišwa go fediša dititelego tše di amanago le teko ya semlao ye e dirwago ka laporathoring.
Amharic: ፈጣን ምርመራ እና ተጨማሪ የአስተዳደር ውሳኔዎች በተመሳሳይ ክሊኒካዊ ግንኙነት ወይም ቢያንስ በተመሳሳይ ቀን የተጠናቀቁ፣ በሽተኛው በሚጠብቅበት ጊዜ፣ ከተለመደው የላቦራቶሪ ፍተሻ ጋር የተያያዙ መዘግየቶችን ለማሸነፍ ተስፋን ሰጥተዋል።

English: However, the availability of cheap, simple, and rapid tests that can be conducted outside laboratories does not automatically ensure successful POC testing.
Luganda: Wabula, okubaawo kw’okukebera okwa layisi, okwangu okukola era okw’amangu okusobola okukolebwa ebweru w’amakeberero tekukakasa butereevu butuukamu bw’okwekebereza ku POC.
Yoruba: Ṣíbẹ̀síbẹ̀, bí àwọn àyẹ̀wò tí ò wọ́n, tó́ rọrùn, tó sì yára ṣe lè ṣeéṣe níta láàbù, ò túnmó sí àrídájú ẹsẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ nínú àṣeyọrí ìṣàyẹ̀wò POC.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, ukutholakala kokuhlolwa okushibhile, okulula, futhi okusheshayo okungenziwa ngaphandle kwama-labhorethri akuqinisekisi ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuhlolwa kwe-POC okuphumelelayo.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, samuwar gwaje-gwaje masu arha da sauƙi da kuma sauri waɗanda za a iya gudanar da su a wajen ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje ba sa tabbatar da nasarar gwajin POC kai-tsaye.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, go hwetšagala ga, diteko tša go se ture, tše bonolo le tše di tseneletšego tšeo di ka dirwago ka ntle ga dilaporathori ga go netefatše teko ya POC ye e atlegilego.
Amharic: ነገር ግን፣ ከላቦራቶሪዎች ውጭ ሊደረጉ የሚችሉ ርካሽ፣ ቀላል፣ እና ፈጣን ሙከራዎች መገኘት የተሳካ የPOC ፍተሻን በራሳቸው አያረጋግጡም።

English: In order to understand the new roles and challenges medical devices such as these encounter, we need to study how diagnostics are used at the POC and integrated into workflow and patient pathways.
Luganda: Okusobola okutegeera emirimu n’okusoomoozebwa ebintu nga bino bye bisiŋŋaana, twetaaga okwekaliriza engeri okukebera gye kukozesebwa ku POC n’engeri gye kuyingizibwa mu ntambuza y’emirimu n’emitendera abalwadde gye bayitamu okujjanjabwa.
Yoruba: Láti ní òye nípa àwọn ipa tuntun àti àwọn ìdojúkọ àwọn ẹrọ ìṣegùn òyìnbó bíi àwọn ìdọjúkọ yìí, a nílo láti ṣe ìwádìí bí àwọn irinṣẹ́ fún àyẹ̀wò ìlera ṣe maa ń di lílò ní POC àti bí wọ́n ṣe maa ń dàpọ̀ mọ́ bí iṣẹ́ ṣe ń lọ àti àwọn ìlànà aláìsàn.
Zulu: Ukuze siqonde izindima ezintsha nezinselele amathuluzi ezokwelapha afana nalokhu kuhlangana, sidinga ukucwaninga ukuthi ukuxilonga kusetshenziswa kanjani ku-POC futhi kuhlanganiswe ekuhambeni komsebenzi nezindlela zesiguli.
Hausa: Domin fahimtar sababbin ayyuka da ƙalubalolin na’urorin likitanci kamar irin waɗannan gamuwa, muna buƙatar yin nazarin yadda ake amfani da binciken lafiya a POC da haɗawa cikin ayyukan aiki da hanyoyin majiyyaci.
Northern Sotho: Gore re kgone go kwešiša mešomo ye meswa le ditlhohlo tšeo ditlabelo tša kalafo tša go swana le mošomo wo, re hloka go nyakišiša ka fao diphekolo di šomišwago ka gona ka go POC le go kopanywa ka go kelo ya mošomo le go ditsela tša molwetši.
Amharic: እንደ እነዚህ ያሉ የህክምና መሳሪያዎች የሚያጋጥሟቸውን አዲሶቹን ሚናዎች እና ተግዳሮቶችን ለመረዳት፣ የምርመራ ዘዴዎች በPOC እንዴት ጥቅም ላይ እንደሚውሉ እና ወደ የስራ ሂደት እና የታካሚ መንገዶች እንዴት እንደሚዋሃዱ ማጥናት አለብን።

English: This chapter reviews selected results from a qualitative research project on barriers to POC testing in India and South Africa and discusses them comparatively.
Luganda: Essuula eno yeekaliriza ebyazuulibwa ebirondobe okuva mu pulojekiti y’okunoonyereza okw’okulombojja ekwata ku miziziko eri okwekebereza mu POC mu ggwanga lya Buyindi ne South Africa era ebittottola mu ngeri ey’okugeraageranya.
Yoruba: Orí yìí ṣàtúnyẹ̀wò lóri bí èsì àyẹ̀wò tí wọ́n mú láti inú ìwádìí tó dára lóri àwọn ìdènà àyẹ̀wò sí POC ní India àti South Africa, ó sì sọ̀rọ̀ nípa wọn ní ìlànà ìfiwéra.
Zulu: Lesi sahluko sibuyekeza imiphumela ekhethiwe evela kuphrojekthi yocwaningo olusezingeni eliphezulu ngezithiyo ekuhlolweni kwe-POC e-India naseNingizimu Afrika futhi sixoxa ngayo ngokuqhathanisa.
Hausa: Wannan babin yana bitar zaɓaɓɓun sakamako daga ingantattun aikin bincike a kan matsalolin gwajin POC a Indiya da kuma Afirka ta Kudu kuma yana tattauna su ta hanyar kwatanta su.
Northern Sotho: Kgaolo ye e lekodišiša dipoelo tše di kgethilwego go tšwa go protšeke ya dinyakišišo tša boleng ka ga mapheko a teko ya POC ka India le Afrika Borwa le go di ahlaahla di arogane.
Amharic: ይህ ምእራፍ በህንድ እና በደቡብ አፍሪካ ለPOC ሙከራ የጥራት ምርምር ፕሮጀክት እንቅፋት ከሆኑት የተመረጡ ውጤቶችን ይገመግም እና በንፅፅር ያብራራቸዋል።

English: The project used semi-structured interviews and focus group discussions to examine diagnostic practices across major diseases and actors in homes, clinics, communities, hospitals, and laboratories in South Africa and India.
Luganda: Pulojekiti yakozesa okubuuzibwa n’okukubaganya ebirowoozo okw’omu bibinja okusobola okwekaliriza enkola z’okukebera okwetooloola endwadde enkulu n’abantu abakulu mu maka, obulwaliro, ebitundu, amalwaliro, n’amakeberero ag’enjawulo mu ggwanga lya South Africa ne Buyindi.
Yoruba: Àkànṣe iṣẹ́ náà lo àwọn ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò tó létò-díẹ̀ àti ìjíròrò láàárín àwọn ọ̀wọ́ èèyàn tó ní àbùdá kan tàbí òmíràn tó jọra láti ṣàgbéyèwò àwọn ìdámọ́ àìsàn tí a bá wo àwọn àìsàn pàtàkì àti àwọn olùkópa ní àwọn ìdílé, ilé-ìwòsàn, agbègbè, ile-ìwòsàn ńlá àti àwọn láàbù ní South Africa àti India.
Zulu: Le phrojekthi isebenzise izingxoxo ezingahleliwe kanye nezingxoxo zamaqembu ukuze kuhlolwe izindlela zokuxilonga kuzo zonke izifo ezinkulu kanye nabalingisi emakhaya, emitholampilo, emiphakathini, ezibhedlela, nasemalabhorethri eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Hausa: Aikin ya yi amfani da tambayoyin da aka fara tsara su da kuma tattaunawa ta rukuni domin nazarin ayyukan bincike a cikin manyan cututtuka da kuma masu taka muhimmiyar rawa a gidaje da dɗakunan shan magani da al’ummomi da asibitoci da kuma ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje a Afirka ta Kudu da kuma Indiya.
Northern Sotho: Protšeke ye e šomišitše dipotšišonyakišišo tšeo di nyakago dikarabo tša go fa mabaka le dipoledišano tša dihlopha tša nepišo go lekola ditiro tša phekolo go ralala le malwetši a magolo le balwetši ka gae, dikliniking, ditšhabeng, dipetlele, le dilaporathoring ka Afrika Borwa le India.
Amharic: ፕሮጀክቱ በደቡብ አፍሪካ እና ህንድ ውስጥ በቤት፣ ክሊኒኮች፣ ማህበረሰቦች፣ ሆስፒታሎች፣ እና ላቦራቶሪዎች ውስጥ ባሉ ዋና ዋና በሽታዎች እና ተዋናዮች ላይ የመመርመሪያ አሰራሮችን ለመፈተን በከፊል የተዋቀሩ ቃለመጠይቆችን እና የትኩረት ቡድን ውይይቶችን ተጠቅሟል።

English: In comparing selected results, it becomes clear that both countries have very different diagnostic eco-systems that provide very different conditions for POC testing.
Luganda: Mu kugeraageranya ebyazuulibwa ebirondobe, kyeyoleka bulungi nti amawanga gombi galina emiyungo gy’okukebera endwadde gya njawulo egiteekawo embeera y’okwekebereza mu POC ey’enjawulo ddala.
Yoruba: Nínú ìfiwéra àwọn èsì àyẹ̀wò tí wọ́n yàn, ó fi hàn gbangba pé àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè méjẹ́èjì ní àgbéyẹ̀wò agbègbè ohun abẹ̀mí tó yàtò gédégbé, èyí tó pèsè àwọn ipò tó yàtò dàada fún ìṣàyèwò POC.
Zulu: Ekuqhathaniseni imiphumela ekhethiwe, kuyacaca ukuthi omabili amazwe anezinhlelo zokuxilonga ezihluke kakhulu ezihlinzeka ngezimo ezihluke kakhulu zokuhlolwa kwe-POC.
Hausa: A wajen kwatanta zaɓaɓɓun sakamakon, ya bayyana a fili cewa ƙasashen biyu suna da tsarin yanayin bincike daban-daban waɗanda suke bayar da yanayi daban-daban domin gwajin POC.
Northern Sotho: Ge go bapetšwa dipoelo tše di kgethilwego, go ba molaleng gore dinaga tše ka bobedi di na le diphedišano ta diphedi tše di fapanego tšeo di phekolwago tšeo di fanago ka maemo ao a fapanego kudu a teko ya POC.
Amharic: የተመረጡ ውጤቶችን በማነፃፀር፣ ሁለቱም ሀገራት ለPOC ፍተሻ በጣም የተለያዩ ሁኔታዎችን የሚያቀርቡ በጣም የተለያዩ የምርመራ ስነ-ምህዳሮች እንዳላቸው ግልፅ ሆኗል።

English: The chapter concludes by reflecting on how to take such insights into account when designing POC testing programs.
Luganda: Essuula ewunzika n’okwefumiitiriza ku ngeri y’okutunuulira ensonga ng’ezo mu kuteekateeka enteekateeka z’okwekebereza mu POC.
Yoruba: Orí yìí dópin pẹ̀lú ìsọ̀rọ̀ nípa bí wọ́n ṣe máa mú àwọn òye wọ̀nyí sínú èrò nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń tí wọ́n bá ń ṣẹ̀tò ìṣàyẹ̀wò POC.

Northern Sotho: Kgaolo ye e fetša ka go laetša ka fao re ka hlokomedišišago tsebo yeo ge go hlangwa mananeo a teko ya POC.

English: Poor point-of-care testing in South Africa and India delays healthcare
Luganda: Okwekebereza mu bifo ewafunibwa obujjanjabi okw’ekibogwe mu ggwanga lya South Africa n’erya Buyindi kulwisa okujjanjaba abalwadde
Yoruba: Àyẹ̀wò ṣíṣe ní ibi-ìtọ́jú tó kùdíẹ̀-káàtó ní South Africa àti India ń ṣe ìdádúró fún ìtọ́jú-ìlera.
Zulu: Ukuhlola kwezindawo zokunakekela okungekuhle eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya kubambezela ukunakekelwa kwezempilo
Hausa: Ƙarancin gwajin kulawa a Afirka ta Kudu da Indiya yana jinkirta kiwon lafiya
Northern Sotho: Teko ya mafelong a tlhokomelo ka Afrika Borwa le India e ditela tlhokomelo ya maphelo
Amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ እና በህንድ ውስጥ ያለው ደካማ ከላብራቶሪ ውጪ የህክምና ምርመራ የጤና እንክብካቤን ያዘገያል

English: Point-of-care (POC) refers to healthcare tests that are done in the same place where the patient receives care, rather than sending patient samples away to a laboratory for testing.
Luganda: Ebifo ewafunibwa obujjanjabi (POC) kitegeeza okukebera endwadde okukolebwa mu kifo kyekimu omulwadde gy’ajjanjabirwa, ewatali kusindika sampolo z’abalwadde mu kkeberero ery’ebweru okuzikebera.
Yoruba: Ibi-ìtọ́jú (POC) ń tọ́ka sí àwọn àyẹ̀wò ìtọ́jú-ìlera tí wọ́n ṣe níbi kan náà tí àwọn aláìsàn ti ń gbà ìtọ́jú, ju kí wọ́n fi àwọn àpẹẹrẹ-ẹ̀yà-ara wọn ráńṣẹ́ sí láàbù kan fún àyẹ̀wò.
Zulu: INdawo yokunakekela (POC) ibhekisela ekuhlolweni kokunakekelwa kwezempilo okwenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho isiguli sithola khona ukunakekelwa, kunokuba kuthunyelwe amasampula esiguli endaweni yokucwaninga ukuze ahlolwe.
Hausa: Wurin Kulawa (POC) yana nufin gwaje-gwajen kiwon lafiya da ake yi a wuri guda inda majiyyaci yake samun kulawa, maimakon aika samfuran marasa lafiya zuwa ɗakin gwaje-gwaje domin gwaji.
Northern Sotho: Lefelo la tlhokomelo (POC) e ra diteko tša tlhokomelo ya maphelo tšeo di dirwago lefelong le tee fao molwetši  a hwetšago tlhokomeo gona, sebakeng sa go romela molwetši disampole kgole laporathoring go yo dirwa diteko.
Amharic: ከላብራቶሪ ውጪ የህክምና ምርመራ (POC) የታካሚ ናሙናዎችን ወደ ላቦራቶሪ ለፍተሻ ከመላክ ይልቅ፣ በሽተኛው እንክብካቤ በሚያገኝበት ቦታ ላይ የሚደረጉ የጤና አጠባበቅ ፍተሻዎችን ያመለክታል።

English: South Africa and India don’t deliver fast and efficient testing because of their poor POC systems and labs.
Luganda: South Africa ne Buyindi tezikola kukebera kwangu era okutuukamu olw’emiyungo gya POC n’amakeberero amabi.
Yoruba: South Africa àti India kìí jíṣẹ́ ìṣàyẹ̀wò tó yára, tó sì dára nítorí àwọn ètò POC àti àwọn láàbù wọn tó kùdíẹ̀-káàtó.
Zulu: INingizimu Afrika ne-India abalethi ukuhlolwa okusheshayo nangempumelelo ngenxa yezinhlelo zabo ezingezinhle ze-POC namalebhu.
Hausa: Afirka ta Kudu da Indiya ba sa isar da gwaji mai sauri da kuma inganci saboda tsarinsu na POC da kuma ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje.
Northern Sotho: Afrika Borwa le India ga di fane ka teko ya ka pela yeo e šomago gabotse ka lebaka la mananeo le dilaporathori tše di fokolago tša go dira POC.
Amharic: ደቡብ አፍሪካ እና ህንድ በደካማ የPOC ስርዓታቸው እና ቤተ ሙከራዎቻቸው ምክንያት ፈጣን እና ቀልጣፋ ፍተሻን አያቀርቡም።

English: POC testing allows patients to have access to fast testing with quick results for the treatment and management of diseases.
Luganda: Okwekebereza mu POC kusobozesa abalwadde okufuna okukeberebwa okw’amangu n’okufuna amangu ebivuddemu okusobola okujjanjaba n’okutangira endwadde.
Yoruba: Ìṣàyẹ̀wò POC fàyè gba àwọn aláìsàn láti ní àyè sí àyẹ̀wò tó yá àti èsì ní kíá fún ìtọ́jú àti ìṣàkóso àwọn àìsàn.
Zulu: Ukuhlolwa kwe-POC kuvumela iziguli ukuthi zikwazi ukufinyelela ekuhlolweni okusheshayo ngemiphumela esheshayo yokwelashwa nokuphathwa kwezifo.
Hausa: Gwajin POC yana ba marasa lafiya damar samun damar yin gwajin sauri tare da sakamako mai sauri don magani da kuma magance cututtuka.
Northern Sotho: Teko ya POC e dumelela balwetši go ba le phihlelelo go teko ya ka pela fa go bago le dipoelo tša ka pela go alafa le go laola malwetši.
Amharic: የPOC ፍተሻ ታካሚዎች ፈጣን ምርመራ ከፈጣን ውጤቶች ጋር የበሽታዎች ሕክምናን እና አያያዝን እንዲያገኙ ያስችላቸዋል።

English: This can be done with relatively cheap and simple machines that can give test results quickly without having to take the samples to labs.
Luganda: Kino kisobola okukolebwa n’ebyuma ebya layisiko era ebyangu okukozesa ebisobola okuwa ebivudde mu kukebera mu bwangu nga tewali bwetaavu bwa kutwala sampolo mu makeberero.
Yoruba: Èyí lè jẹ́ ṣíṣé pẹ̀lú lílo ẹ̀rọ tí ò wọ́n (yàtọ̀ sí àwọn míràn), tó sì rọrùn, èyí tó lè fún wa lésì ìdánwò kíá láì-nílò mímú àwọn àpẹẹrẹ-ẹ̀yà-ara lọ àwọn láàbù.
Zulu: Lokhu kungenziwa ngemishini eshibhile futhi elula enganikeza imiphumela yokuhlolwa ngokushesha ngaphandle kokuhambisa amasampula kumalebhu.
Hausa: Ana iya yin wannan tare da injuna masu arha da sauƙi waɗanda za su iya bayar da sakamakon gwaji cikin sauri ba tare da ɗaukar samfurorin zuwa ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje ba.
Northern Sotho: Se se ka dirwa ka metšehene ya go se ture le ye bonlo yeo e kgnago go fana ka dipoelo tša diteko ka pela ka ntle le go iša disampole dilaporathoring.
Amharic: ይህ በአንፃራዊ ርካሽ እና ቀላል በሆኑ ማሽኖች ናሙናዎችን ወደ ላቦራቶሪ መውሰድ ሳያስፈልግ የፍተሻ ውጤቶችን በፍጥነት ሊሰጥ ይችላል።

English: But there are many challenges in POC that slow down patient care in South Africa and India.
Luganda: Naye waliwo okusoomoozebwa kungi mu POC okusala ku nzijanjaba y’abalwadde mu ggwanga lya South Africa n’erya Buyindi.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n ìpènijà púpọ̀ wà ní POC tó maa ń jẹ́ kí ìtọ́jú aláìsàn falẹ̀ ní South Africa àti India.
Zulu: Kodwa kunezinselelo eziningi ku-POC ezinciphisa ukunakekelwa kweziguli eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Hausa: Amma akwai ƙalubaloli da yawa a cikin POC da suke rage jinkirin kula da majiyyata a Afirka ta Kudu da kuma Indiya.
Northern Sotho: Eupša go na le ditlhohlo tše ntši ka go POC yeo e nantšhago tlhokomelo ya balwetši ka Afrika Borwa le India.
Amharic: ነገር ግን በደቡብ አፍሪካ እና በህንድ የታካሚ እንክብካቤን የሚያዘገዩ ብዙ ፈተናዎች በPOC ውስጥ አሉ።

English: The authors wanted to compare POC testing in South Africa and India so that they could identify problems.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baayagala okugeraageranya okukebera kw’omu POC mu ggwanga lya South Africa n’erya Buyindi basobole okuzuula okusoomoozebwa okuliwo.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé náà fẹ́ kọ́kọ́ ṣe ìfiwéra ìsàyẹ̀wò POC ní South Africa àti India kí wọ́n báa lè ṣe ìdánimọ̀ fún àwọn ìṣòrò.
Zulu: Ababhali babefuna ukuqhathanisa ukuhlolwa kwe-POC eNingizimu Afrika nase-India ukuze babone izinkinga.
Hausa: Mawallafan sun so su kwatanta gwajin POC a Afirka ta Kudu da kuma Indiya domin su iya gano matsalolin.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba be ba nyaka go bapetša teko ya POC ka Afrika Borwa le ka India gore ba kgone go tseba mathata.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ ችግሮችን ለይተው ማወቅ እንዲያስችላቸው በደቡብ አፍሪካ እና በህንድ የPOC ፍተሻን ማወዳደር ይፈልጋሉ።

English: They held interviews and group meetings with healthcare workers, patients and medical device companies from September, 2012, to June, 2013, in both countries.
Luganda: Baategeka okubuuzibwa awamu n’ensisinkano n’abasawo, abalwadde n’ebitongole ebikola ebintu ebikozesebwa mu malwaliro okuva mu Gwomwenda, 2012, okutuuka mu Gwomukaaga, 2013, mu mawanga gombi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò àti ìpàdé ọlọ́wọ̀ọ̀wọ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìtọ́jú-ìlera, àwọn aláìsàn àti àwọn iléeṣẹ́ tó ń ta ẹ̀rọ̀ ìṣògùn láti Ọ̀wẹ̀wẹ̀, 2012, sí Agẹmọ, 2013, ní orílẹ̀-èdè méjéèjì.
Zulu: Babambe izingxoxo nemihlangano yamaqembu nabasebenzi bezempilo, iziguli kanye nezinkampani zemishini yezokwelapha kusukela ngoMandulo, 2012, kuya kuNhlangulana, 2013, kuwo omabili la mazwe.
Hausa: Sun gudanar da tambayoyi da tarurruka na rukuni tare da ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya da majiyyata da kamfanonin na’urorin kiwon lafiya daga watan Satumba na shekarar 2012, zuwa watan Yuni na shekarar 2013, a cikin ƙasashen biyu.
Northern Sotho: Ba swere dipoledišano le dikopano tša dihlopha le bašomi ba tlhokomelo ya maphelo, balwetši le dikhamphani tša ditlabelo tša kalafo go thoma ka Setemere, 2012, go fihla ka June, 2013, ka dinageng tše ka bobedi.
Amharic: በሁለቱም ሀገራት፣ ከሴፕቴምበር 2012፣ እስከ ሰኔ 2013፣ ድረስ ከጤና አጠባበቅ ሰራተኞች፣ ታካሚዎች እና የህክምና መሳሪያ ኩባንያዎች ጋር ቃለ ምልልስ እና የቡድን ስብሰባዎችን አድርገዋል።

English: They asked about POC processes and problems.
Luganda: Baabuuza ebibuuzo ku mitendera gya POC awamu n’ebizibu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n bèrè nípa àwọn ìlànà àti ìṣòro POC.
Zulu: Babuze ngezinqubo nezinkinga ze-POC.
Hausa: Sun yi tambaya game da hanyoyi da mtsalaolin POC.
Northern Sotho: Ba botšišitše ka ga ditshepedišo le mathata a POC.
Amharic: ስለ POC ሂደቶች እና ችግሮች ጠይቀዋል።

English: In public healthcare, India uses multiple small labs and do basic tests, but their labs are not given enough money, so they don’t have enough materials to do the testing.
Luganda: Mu malwaliro ga gavumenti, eggwanga lya Buyindi likozesa amakeberero amatono era likola okukebera okusookerwako, naye amakeberero gaabwe tegaweebwa nsimbi zimala, olwo ne kiba nga tegalina bikozesebwa ebimala okukebera endwadde.
Yoruba: Nínú ìtọ́jú-ìlera àwùjọ, India ń lo àwọn láàbù kékeré púpọ̀, wọ́n sì ń ṣe àwọn àyẹ̀wò ìpìlẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n àwọn láàbù náà ò gba owó tó tó, nítorí èyí wọn ò ní ohun èlò tó péye láti ṣàyẹ̀wò náà.
Zulu: Ekunakekelweni kwezempilo komphakathi, i-India isebenzisa amalebhu amancane amaningi futhi yenza izivivinyo eziyisisekelo, kodwa amalebhu abo awanikezwa imali eyanele, ngakho awanazo izinto ezanele zokwenza ukuhlolwa.
Hausa: A cikin lafiyar jama'a, Indiya tana amfani da ƙananan ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje da yawa kuma suna yin gwaje-gwaje na yau da kullum, amma ba a ba wa ɗakunan gwaje-gwajensu isasshen kuɗi, don haka ba su da isassun kayan da za su yi gwajin.
Northern Sotho: Ka tlhokomelong ya maphelo a setšhaba, India e šomiša dilaporathori tše nnyane tše ntši gomme ya dira dteko tša mtheo, eupša dilaporathori tša bona ga di fiwe tšhelete ye ntši, ka fao ga di na le ditlabelo tše ntši go dira diteko.
Amharic: በሕዝብ ጤና አጠባበቅ፣ ህንድ ብዙ ትንንሽ ቤተ ሙከራዎችን ትጠቀማለች እና መሰረታዊ ፍተሻዎችን ታደርጋለች፣ ነገር ግን ቤተ-ሙከራዎቻቸው በቂ ገንዘብ አልተሰጣቸውም፣ ስለዚህ ምርመራውን ለማድረግ በቂ ቁሳቁሶች የላቸውም።

English: Patients are often told to come back on another day or to go somewhere else, which causes problems for the patients.
Luganda: Abalwadde batera okugambibwa okukomawo ku lunaku olulala oba okugenda ewantu ewalala, ekireetera abalwadde obuzibu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n maa ń ṣábà sọ fún àwọn aláìsàn pé kí wọ́n padà wá ní ọjọ́ míràn tàbí kí wọ́n lọ ibọ̀ míràn, èyí tó maa ń fa wàhálà fún àwọn aláìsàn.
Zulu: Iziguli zivame ukutshelwa ukuthi zibuye ngolunye usuku noma ziye kwenye indawo, okubangela izinkinga ezigulini.
Hausa: Sau da yawa ana gaya wa marasa lafiya su dawo wata rana ko kuma su tafi wani wuri, wanda hakan yake haifar da matsala ga marasa lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Balwetši gantši ba botšwa gore ba bowe ka letšatši le lengwe goba ba ye go gongwe, gomme se se baka mathata go balwetši.
Amharic: ብዙውን ጊዜ ታካሚዎች በሌላ ቀን ተመልሰው እንዲመጡ ወይም ወደ ሌላ ቦታ እንዲሄዱ ይነገራቸዋል፣ ይህም ለታካሚዎች ችግርን ይፈጥራል።

English: The researchers also noticed that sometimes patients are tested but it takes long for the results to come back, and they find it hard to get in touch with their doctor afterwards.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baazuula ng’ebiseera ebimu abalwadde bakeberebwa naye kitwala ebbanga ddene ebivudde mu kukebera okukomawo, ate era nga bazibuwalirwa okukwatagana n’omusawo waabwe oluvannyuma.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣẹ̀wádìí náà tún sàkíyèsí pé nígbà míràn, wọ́n maa ń ṣàyẹ̀wò fún àwọn aláìsàn ṣùgbọ́n ó maa ń pẹ́ kí èsì tó jáde, ó sì maa ń le láti rí dókítà lẹ́yìn-ọ̀-rẹyìn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde baqaphela ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi iziguli ziyahlolwa kodwa kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthi imiphumela ibuye, futhi bakuthola kunzima ukuthintana nodokotela wabo ngemva kwalokho.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma lura cewa a wasu lokuta ana gwada marasa lafiya amma sai a ɗauki lokaci mai tsawo kafin sakamakon ya dawo, kuma suna samun wahalar tuntuɓar likitansu bayan haka.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba lemogile gore ka dinako tše dingwe balwetši ba dirwa diteko eupša go tšea lebaka le letelele gore dipoelo di bowe, gomme ba hwetša go le boima go kgokagana le ngaka ya bona ka morago ga fao.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ታካሚዎች ምርመራ እንደሚደረግላቸው ነገር ግን ውጤቱ ተመልሶ እስኪመጣ ድረስ ረጅም ጊዜ እንደሚፈጅ፣ እና ከዚያ በኋላ ከሐኪማቸው ጋር መገናኘት እንደሚከብዳቸው አስተውለዋል።

English: The participants said that there should be more labs in hospitals, and that testing could be done at the same place where patients enter.
Luganda: Abeetabi baagamba nti wasaanye wabeewo amakeberero agawera mu malwaliro, ate era nti okukebera kusobola okukolebwa mukifo kimu abalwadde mwe bayingira.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùkópa náà ní ó yẹ kí láàbù tó pọ̀ wà ní àwọn ilé-ìwòsan, àti pé, ṣíṣe àyẹ̀wò gbọ́dọ̀ wáyé ní ibi kan náà tí aláìsàn bá wọ̀.
Zulu: Abahlanganyeli bathi kufanele kube namalabhu amaningi ezibhedlela, nokuthi ukuhlolwa kungenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho kungena iziguli.
Hausa: Masu shiga binciken sun ce ya kamata a ƙara yawan ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje a asibitoci, kuma ana iya yin gwajin a daidai wurin da marasa lafiya suke shiga.
Northern Sotho: Bakgathatema ba boletše gore go swanetše go ba le dilaporathori tše ntši ka dipetlele, le gore diteko di ka dirwa lefelong le tee fao balwetši ba tsenago gona.
Amharic: በሆስፒታሎች ውስጥ ብዙ ላብራቶሪዎች መኖር እንዳለባቸው ተሳታፊዎቹ ገልፀው፣ ህሙማን በሚገቡበት ቦታ ላይ ምርመራው ሊደረግ ይችላል ብለዋል።

English: They also said that follow-ups, treatments or counselling should also happen at the same place.
Luganda: Baayongerako era ne bagamba nti okulondoola abalwadde, okujjanjaba oba okubuulirira nakwo kusaanye kukolebwe mu kifo kyekimu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pe àwọn àtúnyẹ̀wò, ìtọ́jú tàbí ìgbani-nímọ̀ràn gbọ́dọ̀ tún wáyé ní ibi kan náà.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi ukulandelela, ukwelashwa noma ukwelulekwa kufanele kwenzeke endaweni efanayo.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun ce ya kamata a yi bibiyar da jiyya ko bayar da shawara a wuri guda.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gape gore ditatišišo, dikalafo goba keletšo le tšona di swanetše go dirwa lefelong le tee.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ክትትሎች፣ ህክምናዎች ወይም ምክሮች በተመሳሳይ ቦታ መከናወን አለባቸው ብለዋል።

English: In South Africa, they found that in public healthcare, 1 company handles all the testing, so the samples go to this company.
Luganda: Mu ggwanga lya South Africa, baazuula nga mu malwaliro ga gavumenti, kampuni 1 y’ekwasaganya okukebera kwonna, era sampolo zonna zigenda ku kampuni eno.
Yoruba: Ní South Africa, wọ́n ṣàwárí pé ní ibi-ìtọ́jú àwùjọ, iléeṣẹ̀ 1 ló ń ṣàkóso gbogbo àyẹ̀wò náà, bẹ́ẹ̀ iléeṣẹ́ náà ni gbogbo àpẹẹrẹ-ẹ̀yà-ara ń lọ.
Zulu: ENingizimu Afrika, bathole ukuthi ekunakekelweni kwezempilo komphakathi, inkampani eyodwa ephethe konke ukuhlolwa, ngakho amasampula aya kule nkampani.
Hausa: A ƙasar Afirka ta Kudu, sun gano cewa a cikin lafiyar jama'a, kamfani 1 ne yake gudanar da duk gwajin, don haka samfurorin suna zuwa ga wannan kamfani.
Northern Sotho: Ka Afrika Borwa, ba hweditše gore ka tlhokomelong ya maphelo ya setšhaba, khamophani ye 1 e dira diteko ka moka, ka fao disampole di ya khamphaning ye.
Amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ፣ በሕዝብ ጤና አጠባበቅ ውስጥ፣ 1 ኩባንያ ሁሉንም ምርመራዎች እንደሚያስተናግድ ደርሰውበታል፤ ስለዚህ ናሙናዎቹ ወደዚህ ኩባንያ ይሄዳሉ።

English: Some basic tests are done at the point of care, and the patients do get the results quickly.
Luganda: Okukebera okusookerwako okumu kukolebwa mu kifo ewafunibwa obujjanjabi, era abalwadde ne bafuna ebivuddemu mu bwangu.
Yoruba: Àwọn àyẹ̀wò ìpilẹ̀ maa ń di ṣíṣe ní ibi ìtọ́jú, àwọn aláìsàn sì maa ń gba èsì wọn ní kíákíá.
Zulu: Okunye ukuhlola okuyisisekelo kwenziwa endaweni yokunakekelwa, futhi iziguli zithola imiphumela ngokushesha.
Hausa: Ana yin wasu ƙananan gwaje-gwaje a wurin kulawa, kuma marasa lafiya suna samun sakamakon da sauri.
Northern Sotho: Diteko tše dingwe tša motheo di dirwa ka lefelong la tlhokomelo, gomme balwetši ba hwetša dipoelo ka pela.
Amharic: አንዳንድ መሰረታዊ ምርመራዎች ከላብራቶሪ ውጪ የህክምና ምርመራ ቦታ ላይ ይከናወናሉ፣ እናም ታካሚዎች ውጤቶቹን በፍጥነት ያገኛሉ።

English: HIV and TB tests take longer and so follow-ups or treatments are also delayed.
Luganda: Okukebera HIV ne TB kutwala ebbanga ddene ne kiba ng’okulondoola oba obujjanjabi nabyo birwawo okufunibwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn àyẹ̀wò HIV àti TB maa ń pẹ́ ju àwọn yóòkù lọ, nítorí èyí, gbogbo àtúnyẹ̀wò àti àwọn ìtọ́jú maa ń ní ìdádúró.
Zulu: Ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV ne-TB kuthatha isikhathi eside ngakho-ke ukulandelela noma ukwelashwa nakho kuyabambezeleka.
Hausa: Gwaje-gwajen cutar HIV da kuma TB suna ɗaukar lokaci mai tsawo don haka, ana jinkirin bibiyar ko jiyya.
Northern Sotho: Diteko tša HIV le TB di tšea lebaka le letelele gomme ka fao ditatišišo tša malwetši goba dikalafo le tšona di a ditelega.
Amharic: የኤችአይቪ እና የቲቢ ምርመራዎች ረዘም ያለ ጊዜ ስለሚወስዱ ክትትሎች ወይም ህክምናዎች እንዲሁ ዘግይተዋል።

English: Other delays are because of transport, incorrect spelling of patients’ names, mislabelling of samples, and the breakdown of computer systems.
Luganda: Okulwisibwa okulala kuva ku ntambula, empandiika y’amannya g’abalwadde enkyamu, okukola ensobi mu kulamba sampolo, awamu n’emiyungo gya kompyuta okukyankalana.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìdádúró yóókù maa ń wáyé nítorí ìgbékiri, àìkọrúkọ àwọn aláìsàn dáada, àìfàmì sí àwọn àpẹ̀ẹ̀rẹ̀ lọ́nà tó tọ́, àti bí àwọn ẹ̀rọ kọ̀ḿpútà ṣe ń bàjẹ́.
Zulu: Okunye ukubambezeleka kungenxa yezokuthutha, ukupelwa ngendlela engalungile kwamagama eziguli, ukubhalwa ngokungeyikho kwamasampula, kanye nokuwohloka kwamasistimu ekhompyutha.
Hausa: Sauran jinkirin su ne saboda sufuri, kuskuren rubuta sunayen marasa lafiya, ɓata sunan samfururori da kuma rushewar na’urar kwamfuta.
Northern Sotho: Dititelego tše dingwe ke ka lebaka la dinamelwa, mepeleto ye e phošagetšego ya maina a balwetši, go se leipole disampole ka fao go nepegetšego, le go phuhlama ga mananeo a khomphutha.
Amharic: ሌሎች መዘግየቶች በትራንስፖርት፣ የታካሚዎች ስምን በትክክለኛ የፊደል አጻጻፍ ያለመጻፍ፣ የናሙናዎች የተሳሳተ ስያሜ፣ እና የኮምፒዩተር ስርዓቶች መበላሸት ምክንያት ናቸው።

English: For HIV testing, some labs used different methods of testing, and this gives unreliable results.
Luganda: Mu kukebera HIV, amakeberero agamu gaakozesa obukodyo bw’okukebera bwa njawulo, era nga kino kivaamu okufuna ebivudde mu kukebera ebiteesigika.
Yoruba: Fún àyẹ̀wò HIV, àwọn láàbù míràn ń lo ọ̀nà àyẹ̀wò oríṣiríṣi, èyí tó maa ń fún wa ní èsì àyẹ̀wò tí ò ṣẹẹ́ fọkàntán.
Zulu: Ekuhloleni i-HIV, amanye amalebhu asebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlola, futhi lokhu kunikeza imiphumela engathembekile.
Hausa: Domin gwajin cutar HIV, wasu ɗakunan gwaje-gwaje suna yin amfani da hanyoyi daban-daban na gwaji, kuma wannan yana bayar da sakamako marar inganci.
Northern Sotho: Go teko ya HIV, dilaporathori tše dingwe di šomišitše mekgwa ye e fapafapanego ya teko, gomme se se fa dipoelo tša go se tshephagale.
Amharic: ለኤችአይቪ ምርመራ፣ አንዳንድ ላቦራቶሪዎች የተለያዩ የመመርመሪያ ዘዴዎችን ተጠቅመዋል፣ ይህ ደግሞ አስተማማኝ ያልሆኑ ውጤቶችን ይሰጣል።

English: They found that patients try to get HIV testing based on the distance to the site or the type of test, and because of this they sometimes use a different identity card, which causes problems when trying to get follow-up meetings.
Luganda: Baazuula ng’abalwadde bagezaako okwekebeza HIV okusinziira ku lugendo oluliwo okutuuka ku kifo ewakebererwa oba okusinziira ku kika ky’okukebera, era olw’ensonga eno, oluusi bakozesa endagamuntu ey’enjawulo, ekireetawo obuzibu mu kugezaako okubalondoola.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàwárí pé àwọn aláìsàn maa ń gbìnyànjú àti ṣàyẹ̀wò HIV nítorí bí ibẹ̀ ṣe jìnnà sí tàbí irúfẹ́ àyẹ̀wò náà, nítorí èyí, wọ́n á máa lo káàdì ìdánimọ̀ tó yàtọ̀, èyí tó maa ń fa wàhálà nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń gbìnyànjú àti rí àwọn ìpàdé fún àtúnyẹ̀wò.
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi iziguli ziyazama ukuhlolelwa igciwane lengculazi ngokwebanga lendawo noma uhlobo lokuhlolwa, futhi ngenxa yalokhu kwesinye isikhathi zisebenzisa umazisi ohlukile, okudala izinkinga uma zizama ukuthola imihlangano yokulandelela.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa marasa lafiya suna ƙoƙarin yin gwajin cutar HIV bisa la’akari da nisan wurin ko kuma nau'in gwajin, kuma saboda haka wasu lokuta suna amfani da katin shaida na daban, wanda yake haifar da matsala a yayin da ake ƙoƙarin samun bibiyar baya.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore balwetši ba leka go hwetša teko ya HIV go ya ka bokgole bja go fihla lefelong leo la diteko goba mohuta wa teko, gomme ka lebaka la se ka dinako tše dingwe ba šomiša karata ya boitsebišo ye e fapafapanego, yeo e bakago mathata ge ba leka go hwetša dikopano tša ka moragonyana.
Amharic: ታካሚዎች የኤችአይቪ ምርመራ ለማድረግ የሚሞክሩት ከቦታው ካለው ርቀት ወይም ከምርመራው ዓይነት አንጻር ሲሆን፣ በዚህም ምክንያት አንዳንድ ጊዜ የተለየ የመታወቂያ ካርድ በመጠቀማቸው፣ የክትትል ስብሰባዎችን ለማግኘት ሲሞክሩ ችግሮችን እንደሚፈጥር ደርሰውበታል።

English: The researchers suggested that healthcare workers must work together to share the workload.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baateesa nti abasawo bateekeddwa okukolera awamu okusobola okugabana emirimu.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣẹ̀wádìí náà dábàá pé àwọn òṣìṣé tó ń ṣètọ́jú ìlera gbọ́dọ̀ ṣiṣẹ́ papọ̀ láti pín iṣẹ́ náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo kumele basebenzisane ukuze babelane ngomsebenzi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar cewa dole ne ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya su yi aiki tare don raba nauyin aikin.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišintše gore bašomi ba tlhokomelo ya maphelo ba swanetše go šmišana mmogo go abelana ka mošomo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የጤና አጠባበቅ ሰራተኞች የስራ ጫናውን ለመጋራት በጋራ መስራት እንዳለባቸው ጠቁመዋል።

English: They said when new HIV testing kits come in, workers should be re-trained and that systems must be updated.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ebikozesebwa okukebera HIV ebipya bwe bireetebwa, abakozi basaanye baddemu batendekebwe ate era emiyungo giteekeddwa okuzzibwa obuggya.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní nígbà tí àwọn ohun èlò tí wọ́n fi ń ṣàyẹ̀wò HIV bá de, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ gbọ́dọ̀ tún iṣẹ́ kọ́, àti pé àwọn ètò gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ èyí tí wọ́n á mú dójú ìwọ̀n.
Zulu: Bathe uma kungena izinsiza ezintsha zokuhlolela igciwane lengculazi kumele abasebenzi baqeqeshwe kabusha futhi nezinhlelo kumele zilungiswe.
Hausa: Sun ce lokacin da sababbin na’urorin gwajin cutar HIV suka shigo, ya kamata a sake horar da ma’aikata kuma dole ne a sabunta tsarin.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore ge go etla ditlabelo tše diswa tša teko ya HIV, bašomi ba swanetše go hlahlwa leswa le gore mananeo a swanetše go mpshafatšwa.
Amharic: አዳዲስ የኤችአይቪ መመርመሪያ ስንቂቶች ሲመጡ፣ ሰራተኞች እንደገና መሰልጠን እና ስርአቶች መዘመን አለባቸው ብለዋል።

English: The authors compared the POC data from both countries and they suggested that authorities must look at POC properly before adding new products or devices.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baageraageranya obubaka bwa POC okuva mu mawanga gombi era ne bateesa nti abavunaanyizibwa bateekeddwa okutunuulira obulungi POC nga tebannaleetawo kyamaguzi oba kikozeso kyonna ekipya kye bongerako.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé náà ṣe ìfiwéra dátà POC láti oríl̀ẹ̀-èdè méjéèjì, wọ́n sì dábàá pé ki àwọn olùdarí wo POC dáada kí wọ́n tó fi àwọn ọjà tàbí èrọ tuntun kun.
Zulu: Ababhali baqhathanise ingcobelelo ye-POC evela emazweni omabili futhi baphakamisa ukuthi iziphathimandla kufanele zibheke i-POC kahle ngaphambi kokwengeza imikhiqizo emisha noma amadivayisi.
Hausa: Marubutan sun kwatanta bayanan POC daga ƙasashen biyu kuma sun bayar da shawarar cewa dole ne hukumomi su kalli POC da kyau kafin ƙara sababbin kayayyaki ko na’urori.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba ile ba bapetša tshedimošo ya POC go tšwa ka dinageng tše ka bobedi gomme ba ile ba šišinya gore ba taolo ba swanetše go lebelela POC ka maleba pele ga ge ba ka tsenya ditšweletšwa tše diswa goba ditlabelo.
Amharic: ደራሲዎቹ የሁለቱም ሀገራት የPOC መረጃን አወዳድረው እና አዳዲስ ምርቶችን ወይም መሳሪያዎችን ከመጨመራቸው በፊት ባለስልጣናት POCን በትክክል እንዲመለከቱ ጠቁመዋል።

English: They also said more effort needs to be put into dealing with the workloads in the labs and understanding the role that a patient plays in their own healthcare.
Luganda: Baayongerako era ne bagamba nti wakyaliwo omulimu munene mu kukwasaganya emirimu gy’omu makeberero awamu n’okutegeera omulimu omulwadde gw’akola mu kujjanjabwa kwe.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé wọ́n nílò àti fi akitiyan tó pọ̀ sínú mímójútó bí iṣẹ́ ṣe pọ̀ tó ní àwọn láàbù àti níní òye nípa ipa tí aláìsàn ń kó lóri ìlera ara wọn.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi kumele kwenziwe umzamo omkhulu ekubhekaneni nenqwaba yomsebenzi emalebhu kanye nokuqonda indima edlalwa isiguli ekunakekelweni kwaso kwezempilo.
Hausa: Har wa yau, sun ce ya kamata a ƙara himma wajen tinkarar yawan aiki a ɗakin gwaje-gwaje da fahimtar irin rawar da mara lafiya yake takawa a fannin kiwon lafiyarsa.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gape gore matsapa a mantši a swanetše go dirišwa ge go šongwa ka bontši bja mešomo ka dlaporathoring le go kwešiša mošomo wo molwetši a o ralokago ka tlhokomelong ya maphelo ya bona.
Amharic: በላብራቶሪ ውስጥ ያለውን የስራ ጫና ለመቋቋም እና አንድ ታካሚ በራሱ የጤና እንክብካቤ ውስጥ የሚጫወተውን ሚና ለመረዳት የበለጠ ጥረት ማድረግ እንደሚያስፈልግም ነው የተናገሩት።

English: The authors of this paper were from South Africa, India, Canada and the Netherlands.
Luganda: Abawandiisi b’olupapula luno baali bava mu ggwanga lya South Africa, Buyindi, Canada ne Budaaki.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé fún ìwé yìí wá láti South Africa, India, Canada àti Netherlands.
Zulu: Ababhali baleli phepha bebeqhamuka eNingizimu Afrika, eNdiya, eCanada naseNetherlands.
